items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 39:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the inclusion of Aba and Ima in the Mazal? Behold, Aba and Ima of Atzilut are rooted in the Bina of AA, namely in his throat, being in the stature of SAG, whose upper aspect is the Bina of the lights, as is known. Now, this Bina, in which Aba and Ima are rooted, was in the head of AA at the time of the coming out of his Mochin in the Reisha de Lo It Yeda; but at the time of birth the Reisha de Lo It Yeda was corrected in the Malchut of the second restriction, and therefore the Chochma Stima'ah of AA was corrected in the Nukva in the secret of the sockets of the eyes, and it took the Bina out from the head to the throat. And it is known that this Bina of AA does not return to the head and does not attain the stature of Hochma again, except through the MAN of the hairs, which come from the aspect of the Malchut of the first restriction, which served the stature of AA at the time of their coming out in the Reisha de Lo It Yeda in the secret of MAN and garments of the Mochin, except that they came out from there at the time of birth because of the Malchut of the second restriction, with which the Reisha de Lo It Yeda was corrected, as above. And now that Bina returns to the head, it is necessary that the hairs also return to their former place, to serve as MAN and garments of the Mochin as before. Behold, that the coming out of the hairs from the vessels of the Mochin to become Makifim, and the coming out of Bina from the head of AA to the throat, are one matter, both at the time of smallness and at the time of greatness. For in smallness, Bina descended to the aspect of the throat and body of AA, and likewise the hairs come out and become external vessels and Makifim; and likewise in greatness, when the hairs return to the head, Bina also returns to her former degree, to be included with Hochma face to face. And this matter also reaches Aba and Ima of Atzilut, whose stature depends on this Bina of AA; therefore they too are found as one aspect with the hairs, both in their smallness and in their greatness, as above in the Bina of AA. And this is the secret of "Aba and Ima are included in the beard," for their stature of AB depends entirely on the beard, since in their smallness, the beard is discerned for them only as the aspect of Makifim, and they have only the aspect of the body of AA without any grip in his head, because of the Bina of AA that came out to the throat, which is the aspect of the body. And when the Mazalot rise to serve as MAN at the time of the return of Bina to the head of AA, then Aba and Ima attain their stature of AB. Behold, that their aspect of AB is entirely included in the beard. (Item 105).
